description: This file contains an abstract class 'DispatcherTest' extending PHPUnit's TestCase, used for testing routing dispatchers within the FastRoute package. It includes multiple test methods, data providers for different routing scenarios, and references external classes such as RouteCollector and FastRoute\simpleDispatcher.

classes.name: DispatcherTest
classes.description: Abstract base class for dispatching tests in FastRoute routing library, providing various test cases and data providers for route dispatch scenarios.

methods.name: getDispatcherClass
methods.description: Abstract method to get the dispatcher class used in tests.

methods.name: getDataGeneratorClass
methods.description: Abstract method to get the data generator class.

methods.name: generateDispatcherOptions
methods.description: Generates configuration options for creating a dispatcher instance based on classes returned by the above abstract methods.

methods.name: testFoundDispatches
methods.description: Tests that dispatching a known route returns the expected handler and arguments.

methods.name: testNotFoundDispatches
methods.description: Tests that dispatching an unknown route results in a NOT_FOUND status.

methods.name: testMethodNotAllowedDispatches
methods.description: Tests that dispatching with a method not allowed returns a METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED status and the correct allowed methods.

methods.name: testDuplicateVariableNameError
methods.description: Ensures that adding routes with duplicate variable placeholder names throws a BadRouteException.

methods.name: testDuplicateVariableRoute
methods.description: Tests that registering two routes with overlapping regex patterns triggers a BadRouteException.

methods.name: testDuplicateStaticRoute
methods.description: Checks that registering identical static routes results in an error.

methods.name: testShadowedStaticRoute
methods.description: Verifies that static routes shadowed by variable routes throw an exception.

methods.name: testCapturing
methods.description: Ensures that regex parameters containing capturing groups are not allowed.

methods.name: provideFoundDispatchCases
methods.description: Provides test cases for scenarios where dispatching should find a matching route.

methods.name: provideNotFoundDispatchCases
methods.description: Provides test cases for scenarios where dispatching should result in a not found.

methods.name: provideMethodNotAllowedDispatchCases
methods.description: Provides test cases where the dispatch receives an allowed route with a method mismatch.
